title: DNA sequencing and quick clean-up
protocol: Incubate 3 μl PCR reaction with 1 μl ExoSAP at 37°C for 15 minutes.
Inactivate the enzyme at 80°C for 15 minutes.
Add 2 μl of 1-2 uM primer, 2 μl of 5x Applied Biosystems BigDye buffer, and 1 μl of ABI-supplied BigDye mix to each tube.
Bring the final volume to 10 μl with ddH₂O.
Cycle using the terminator program: preheat at 96°C followed by 28-30 cycles of [96°C for 20 seconds, 55-60°C for 30 seconds, 60°C for 90 seconds], and then link to a 15°C hold.
Add dry Sephadex G-50 to the Millipore Column Loader.
Remove excess resin from the top of the Column Loader with the scraper supplied.
Place MultiScreen HV Plate upside-down on top of the Column Loader.
Invert both MultiScreen HV Plate and Column Loader, and tap on top of the Millipore Column Loader to release the resin.
Add 300 μl of ddH₂O to each well using a multi-channel pipettor.
Let stand at room temperature for 1-3 hours.
Seal swollen minicolumns with saran wrap and store in the refrigerator at 4°C for several days.
Spin through excess liquid over a reserved collection 96-well plate by taping the column plate to the collection plate and centrifuging for 5 minutes at 2000 rpm.
Add 20 μl of ddH₂O to each reaction before applying with a multichannel pipette to columns.
Align over clean collection tubes and balance plate with collection tubes at other end.
Spin for 5 minutes at 2500 rpm and recover approximately 20 μl.
Freeze reactions if sequencing cannot be done that day.
Run sequences on the automated sequencer (Applied Biosystems).
